timeline.summary: MPS Limited received an income tax assessment order and demand notice of INR 21.78 Cr for AY 2023-24 on April 28, 2026.
MPS Limited’s **Raman Sapra** schedules Q4 & FY2026 audited results earnings call with **Rahul Arora** (Chairman & CEO) on **18 May 2026 at 16:30 IST** per SEBI Listing Regulations.
MPS Limited’s **Mr. Rahul Arora (Chairman & CEO)** and senior management will present Q4 & FY2026 audited results via earnings call on **18 May 2026 at 16:30 UTC+5:30** via Diamond Pass link.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹205.16 Cr (+12.7% YoY), net profit ₹47.04 Cr (-0.1% YoY).
MPS released its Q4 and FY26 earnings presentation on May 15, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹205.16 Cr (+12.7% YoY) and guiding for FY27 EBITDA of ₹300+ Cr.
MPS Limited’s **Raman Sapra** hosted an earnings conference call on 18 May 2026, discussing audited Q4/FY2026 results via audio recording and upcoming transcript.
MPS Limited reported its Q4 and FY26 financial results and earnings call transcript, highlighting record annual profit and an FY27 EBITDA target of ₹300+ Cr.
MPS Limited schedules earnings conference call for investors/analysts on 04 November 2026 at 04:30 PM IST to discuss unaudited Q2 & H1 FY27 results.
